Uniform carpet surface only, without tile grid lines or tile seams. Seamless, tileable texture: the left edge must continue perfectly into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge, with no visible seam, border, frame or vignette when repeated. Even, flat, shadowless, albedo-like lighting with no highlights or cast shadows. Realistic photographic material texture for a gritty first-person survival game set in an abandoned, post-apocalyptic office tower: dusty, worn, muted colours. No objects, no people, no text, no logos, no signage, no labels, no watermarks. Square 1024x1024 canvas.

textures.subject: wide panorama of a destroyed city skyline at overcast dusk with smoke columns (distant backdrop)
textures.tool: Codex CLI built-in native image_gen (one call, no retries; model not reported by the tool)
textures.prompt: A wide panoramic matte-painting backdrop of a destroyed, abandoned city skyline at overcast dusk, as seen from high up inside an office tower looking out across the city. Many ruined skyscrapers and mid-rise office and apartment blocks in the middle distance and far distance, some with collapsed upper floors, blown-out windows, exposed floor slabs and broken steel frames; several tall dark smoke columns rising and drifting; low heavy grey-orange overcast clouds with a dim muted dusk glow near the horizon; hazy atmospheric depth with distant buildings fading into smog; no lights on in any window. The horizon and city sit across the middle band of the image, sky in the upper part and ruined lower city rooftops in the lower part, so it can be cropped to a 2:1 strip. The left and right edges should look continuous for wrapping. Realistic, gritty, muted desaturated colours, post-apocalyptic survival game. No people, no vehicles in the sky, no text, no logos, no signage, no watermark, no window frame and no foreground interior. Widest landscape canvas available (1536x1024 if selectable).
